questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:** All trucks are bikes. All bikes are carts. Some carts are pens.

**Conclusion I:** Some trucks are carts.

**Conclusion II:** No bikes are pens.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

All trucks are bikes.

All bikes are carts.

Some carts are pens.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3f38a0a41be3ac1ebba7dc658a3b30ff9d5ec933652250b2133e89791388813.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trucks are carts → **True **(It is given that all truck are bike and all bike are cart. So, the part of bike which is truck is also cart.)

II. No bikes are pens → **False **(There is no direct relation is given between bikes and pens. So, it can be possible only.)

So, **only conclusion (I) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 4'.***

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

_ FFEF _ _ FF _ F_
questions.solution:
We check the given options, one by one as follows:

Option 1) EEEFE → __**E**__FF/ EF__**E/ E**__FF/ __**F**__F__**E**__ → There is no clear pattern here. 

Option 2) EFFEF → __E__FF/ EF**__F/ F__**FF/ **__E__**F**__F__** → There is no clear pattern here.

Option 3) EFEEF → __E__FF/ EF**__F/ E__**FF/ **__E__**F**__F__** → There is a clear pattern followed here. EFF is repeated. 

Option 4) EFFEE → __E__FF/ EF**__F/ F__**FF/ **__E__**F__E__ → There is no clear pattern here.

Therefore, EFEEF is the combination of letters which completes the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".

questions.question:
Kiran. Pihu, Siya, Leena, Reena and Jiya are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Kiran sits 3rd to the right of Pihu. Siya sits 2nd to the right of Kiran. Leena sits 3rd to the left of Siya. Reena is an immediate neighbour of Leena.

Who sits to the immediate left of Jiya?
questions.solution:
**Given**: Kiran, Pihu, Siya, Leena, Reena, and Jiya are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangements:

1. Kiran sits 3rd to the right of Pihu.

2. Siya sits 2nd to the right of Kiran.

From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63e00ecf2d3896dc6c54bec28a5cdb79bb92fc7e529f357041850812f06e82ca.png] 

3. Leena sits 3rd to the left of Siya.

4. Reena is an immediate neighbour of Leena.

From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03240e2f9a265c417eead3823001ec9abcdc717e9bc841e237a93a15e015ec51.png] 

So, Jiya will occupy the vacant position. We get the final arrangement as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b3f7d3b3d0cb47a628494dd4d5c496694850a624a41f1e31940775adddabeae.png] 

Therefore, Kiran sits to the immediate left of Jiya.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.

questions.question:
If 'I' stands for '+', 'J' stands for '×', 'K' stands for '÷' and 'L' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

(95 K 19) J 7 L 15 I (10 J 4) = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (95 K 19) J 7 L 15 I (10 J 4) = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 I
 J
 K
 L
 
 
 
 

 **Meaning**
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**(95 ÷ 19)**__ × 7 - 15 + __**(10 × 4)**__

⇒ __**5 × 7**__ - 15 + 40

⇒ __**35**__ - 15 __**+ 40**__

⇒ **__75 - 15__ = 60**

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: If 5th May 2010 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 5th June 2022?
questions.solution:
Given: **5th May 2010** was Wednesday.

Now,

2010 to 2022 = 12 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap years and 9 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 9 = 15.

15 odd days → 15/7 = 2 weeks and 1 odd day.

then, 5th May 2022 will be Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 5th May 2022 to 5th June 2022

= 26(May) + 5(June) = 31 days.

= 31 days → 31/7 = 4 weeks and 3 odd days.

So, **5th June 2022** will be Thursday + 3 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
